# Color contrast checker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/contrast-checker/

Calculate the contrast ratio between two opaque sRGB colors and compare it with WCAG AA and AAA text thresholds. Preview a real text sample.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Check dark green text on an off-white background before using the pair in a button or article.

## Limits and checks

Passing a contrast threshold is one part of accessible design. The tool does not audit layout, keyboard navigation or text over images.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
